en: Tokenizers are tools that convert raw text
into tokens and then also token IDs.
So it's in the end the tools these AI labs
built when they first trained their models,
and they keep on inventing on these tools
because of course the better they are able
to split words into meaningful tokens, the
better they're able to capture nuances
between text and to capture the details and
between text and parts that make up text. So
tokenizers are in the end tools that are
needed to make large language models work,
